# Unmodified AppImage runtime source and build information

Runtime source: https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/tree/8f39b89e2ac31e1640b3d3f7e9a5108e6ce805fa
Build scripts and dependency source recipes are preserved in that repository. The runtime is the unmodified upstream binary; its archive provenance is included with this release.

Component source: https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse , https://github.com/vasi/squashfuse , https://git.musl-libc.org/cgit/musl/ , https://github.com/facebook/zstd , https://zlib.net/ . Full component notices are included alongside this file.

OpenGL dispatch source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/libglvnd . Ubuntu 22.04 package copyright and source provenance accompany the Linux package. No graphics vendor driver is redistributed.
